reviews.title: Don’t get suckered
reviews.text: Honestly don’t be me who impulse buys based off one ad that I think is real. Save yourself the money. All it does is ask the problem and then carries on a conversation for as long as you will let it, repeating the same questions over and over again. Then the “breakdown” of the task is literally what you had to break it down to on your own with the 6 million questions. Just use ChatGPT honestly, it’ll do the same thing and more.

reviews.title: This is the app that improves the world

reviews.title: Typical scam
reviews.text: This scam technique is getting old. Making the user waste their time with an extensive survey that shows fake results and fake reviews to manipulate them into thinking they need this app right before showing the purchase screen is something I’ve seen dozens of times. All of these apps are AI generated with no real thought put behind. Shame that they also seem to have bought a lot of 5 star reviews, random influencers on tiktok and Instagram, and that reviews don’t mean anything today.

reviews.title: Completely frustrated
reviews.text: I tried this app today for the first time.  I subscribed for a year.  Hopeful that I might get some help with productivity.  The AI agent interrupted constantly despite my repeated requests for her to slow down and not interrupt. Cancelling only prevents payment from being taken next year.  Not only not more productive, but completely furious and frustrated.

I don’t even know if this is going to work for me. No trail is offered nothing

reviews.title: Maybe a heads up
reviews.text:
Do I download the app. Looks promising. Start in the process. Asks me if it can use the mic. OK, I figure it must check or give some warning, right? No, it starts screaming at me with my name at full volume on the train.
Not cool guys. Not great UX. I’ll give it another try at home, with my headphones in.

reviews.title: Interesting but Frustrating
reviews.text: There are some great features but I overall find several of them very frustrating bc I cannot tailor the experience to best fit my needs. It requires five goal areas but they became repetitive and I needed to narrow the scope. How to earn streaks and points is opaque. There’s nowhere to go to ask for help and when I emailed the support email, no one has responded.

reviews.title: I really want to like this
reviews.text: I want to like this and i want this to work but every so often in the middle of a conversation, the chat will crash. Not the whole app, but just the active chat and always in the middle of me typing a message so it doesn’t save. Sometimes i can recover the chat logs but other times i have to start a whole new chat and lose all progress

reviews.title: Are you kidding me?
reviews.text: You guys made an app to overcome adhd. But added a paywall. One of the biggest things people with adhd hate IS PAYWALLS. Idiots.

reviews.title: Dont waste ur time
reviews.text: I spent a while going through all the onboarding questions only to then try to enroll me in a subscription. Theres no free trial, and you can't do anything on the app if you don't pay, can't even get a feel for what its like. Horrible waste of time

god, i was so happy i thought i dont need to pay and the app is free.. i live in Iran so even 20 dollars is so much for me and even if it wasnt, i cant get the premium from here. i thought i can overcome my adhd for the exams i have coming up in the summer. sry for talking too much🤍 im sure this app is amazing without even using it🤍🤍

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: The app is useless and lacks proper functionalities. I regret subscribing and would not recommend it to anyone even if it was for free.

reviews.title: Payment Gateway After Taking All Info
reviews.text: I do not mind paying for a good service of course, but asking for annual subscription even before I can see what they’ve to offer, is ridiculous to me. Another app I just downloaded, signed up for, just to get spammed for the rest of my life!

reviews.title: Strong dislike
reviews.text: I also came from an ad. Thought I’d finally try it since I’ve seen it over the years. The app itself is very frustrating and I thought the app would give more of a tutorial or direction. You constantly have to tell the AI what your problems are; even if you locked your phone on accident. If they gave you a free trial to try out, I wouldn’t have paid for this. You have to pay their subscription first before you can do anything in the app. I wouldn’t recommend if you’re new to adhd world or to anyone really.

reviews.title: App Glitch
reviews.text: I downloaded the app and paid the subscription fee to start using it. I closed out of the app and now it’s only giving me the option to subscribe again and there’s no way to bypass it. I can’t actually get into the app to use it, although I’ve already subscribed. Not worth it to me!

Much of the text is hidden by buttons in the beginning getting to know you survey. 

I couldn’t go anywhere else once it reached the graph showing how the app will improve my life. I’m assuming the fee structure is beyond that screen because it seemed like that’s where it was headed. 

Couldn’t use it. Couldn’t tell if it is worthwhile based on the part that sort of worked on my se3. Deleted. Bummer.

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: As others have stated, this is made to look like a free app with optional in-app purchases. That is not the case. It takes you through all these questions and then will not let you go any farther unless you pay. Why would I want to pay $18 for a month just to try something I haven’t even been able to test out!? And they push the annual subscription, which again, doesn’t make sense if I haven’t even seen it!

reviews.title: Want my money back
reviews.text: Used task manager for a task and the system won’t mark the task complete, so it is stuck on something I finished a month ago with no recourse on my end to change it. Now it is useless to me.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: It’s absolutely ridiculous that this AI doesn’t have any memory of previous conversations, not even the ones you had half an hour ago. You have to constantly repeat your issues and give it the same context over and over and over again which is extremely frustrating and makes me not want to use it at all. And every single time you want to use the chat it’s gonna give you this long spiel about how to use the chat like it’s your Day 1 every. Single. Time. They have to manipulate you into paying them upfront after taking the survey because if there was a free trial there’s no way I’d sign up for a paid version.

reviews.title: Buggy app.

reviews.title: SCAM
reviews.text: First of all this app is locked behind a paywall and makes all these promises if you pay. No. It’s a complete lie and a scam. It’s just an AI chatbot that couldn’t help me build a simple daily schedule. It did nothing at all. I emailed the company 3 times and heard nothing back, was denied a refund from Apple even though I showed evidence the company lied and does not communicate with customers. They haven’t even replied to any negative reviews. This is a cash grab, a bait and switch. It’s a scam. I filed a complaint with Apple so hoping others do too.

They don’t even give you the option for insurance - even though it’s considered medical/mental health. Probably a scam anyways.

reviews.title: IF TIKTOK BROUGHT YOU HERE
reviews.text: You wasted your time on this app. Spent 10 minutes answering questions and signing my life away for it to ask me to sign up for a subscription. Doesn’t even tell you methods of fixing your adhd it uses. No free version, tutorial video, explanation. Waste of my time so now I’m using my time wisely and writing this review.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text:
People on tiktok do covert ads for this company, they all say the same lines targeted individuals with ADHD. 
I’m not a fan of covert ads, but I am in need of something to help my ADHD, so I thought I might check it out. When you first get the app, it immediately makes you take an extensive survey where you give them tons of personal info. The surveys are poorly designed, its clear they just slapped a prompt into an AI and had it build the app for them. Some questions are even repeated and they didn’t even bother to make the sections the same color scheme. After the survey they immediately take you to a purchase screen. Even though it’s marketed as free with in-app purchases, they  want your money without even letting you SEE what you are paying for first. What a scam.

reviews.title: Not Mac friendly
reviews.text: The app is cool and I am starting to use it more and I paid for one year. I look forward to using it but as most of my work is on the laptop, I thought it would be convenient to do use it on my laptop. The there just isn’t a Mac friendly version of this app. It’s just the app but on your Mac. Which is fine if all the buttons work. There are bugs sometimes and im assuming it’s just how it renders on our screen. Would love to see improvements/an actual desktop view of the app. Will be reviewing this throughout the year. When updates come.

reviews.title: Another subscription
reviews.text: Don’t get it. It’s just another subscription you’ll lose money on

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: Thus is not worth the money. A total scam to trick people struggling into buying a very poor llm. Just use chat gpt.

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text: This app markets itself as free to use with in-app purchases, which is defined by the App Store as optional purchases that improve content or functionality, but there’s nothing optional about this app’s in-app purchases. Once you fill out their questionnaire about your adhd, you’re forced to sign up for a monthly or yearly subscription or else you can’t access any more of the app than the questionnaire you just completed. That level of dishonesty and manipulation made me have no desire to continue using app, benefits be damned.

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY
reviews.text: Totally a waste of money. It tricked me into purchasing a year subscription. I’ve already deleted it. I’m really surprised this works for anyone at this point. I wouldn’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: One of my goal was task management and this app failed miserably. It just asks a bunch of questions and gave no real solutions. Typed my assignment question in the chat and asked to break it down it to manageable steps, it didn’t do that it just asked questions and when I answered it asked more questions. As someone with ADHD I do not have the capacity to deal with this. It gave me anxiety. After one day I had to cancel my subscription. Wasted my $17.99 which also gave me anxiety because I thought It was going to help me manage my assignments in order to be on track for school. There needs to be a free trial.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’m very disappointed in the structure of this app. It’s just spitting prewritten lists at me that are too long and complex for my adhd brain to comprehend. It is not personalized at all.

reviews.title: This is scamy
reviews.text: They try to make you subscribe immediately after answering some pseudo diagnostic questions. The entire app is a hub for AI Chatbot conversations and the analytics are a count of the number of conversations you have with them. Their privacy policy requires you to release all of your conversation and personal data to them. Beware.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: This app does nothing more than a simple google search could do. It’s not flexible and just spits out the same responses over and over. I think this is just a pathetic cash grab because it’s advertised on TikTok by so many creators and the subscription is $18/month! Insanity. Don’t waste your time or money on this app. It’s preying on vulnerable people who just need help with their ADHD symptoms by gouging for money. If you need help, please see a licensed therapist and explore online communities of other people with ADHD (e.g. ADHD subreddits). Just avoid this completely.

reviews.title: No free trial
reviews.text: Do not fall for the sales pressure. It is absolutely unacceptable to ask for payment without even a view of what the service is like.

reviews.title: BUGGY APP DOESNT WORK
reviews.text: I stupidly got the year long subscription thinking the app was much different from what it is. Buggy ai that doesn’t listen/respond to what you’re saying. Tabs that will just disappear if you try to click on them. Little to no real trackable content in the app past a made up “XP” currency it gives you for completely “conversations”. DO NOT GET THIS!! WASTE OF MONEY ENTIRELY!!

reviews.title: can’t access without paying - says it can get rid of adhd symptoms (not possible)
reviews.text: what the title says, this app literally states it will remove your adhd symptoms, which just isn’t a thing, and you can’t even free trial the app without paying. literally can’t access it without paying them a hundred bucks. stupid. accidentally got lured here by one of those tiktokkers who pretend they’re trying to help but are actually just mentioning the app because they are paid to. such a scam.

reviews.title: Don’t get the good reviews
reviews.text: This app is useless. I can’t fathom what other people are getting out of it, and I suspect the positive reviews are fake. It’s a poorly trained LLM that repeats the same trivial recommendations regardless of your input. They don’t give you a free trial, and now I see why - no one would actually pay. I got duped.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: The AI is super formal and the responses barely refer to the conversation. No nuance to the advice. I’ve only used it once but Jesus I could get better advice and therapeutic recommendations from any free ai. Waste of money.

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text:
I honestly have no clue how useful Mind Flow is because there is not even a one week trial period and no money back guarantee and with how unstable the job market is these days It’s simply not reasonable for many including me to just spend hundreds of dollars with no idea if it will help.

I hold hope that this system works however without some sort of guarantee it is simply not worth the risk of paying hundreds for something that could either not work or being a scam.

reviews.title: Subscription Scam
reviews.text: Makes you take a long annoying test before throwing a subscription in your face.

reviews.title: Surprisingly effective
reviews.text: I’m generally a skeptic of AI tools, but I’m actually pleasantly surprised by the effectiveness of Mindflow. It’s like if Duolingo and a therapist had a baby.

reviews.title: game changer if you’re often in high pressure situations
reviews.text: for context: i work in a high stress environment, and am in a senior management position. i’ve been using an executive coach for quite some time now, given it’s difficult to juggle my role with (at times) pretty crippling ADHD. recently downloaded this app to help me when i don’t have access to my coach, and I’ve gotta say… seriously considering replacing my coach with this app. it’s absolutely key to helping me break down my tasks, stay focused, and manage my day/direct reports in a way that actually works for my ADHD brain. I feel so much more in control and less overwhelmed. i’m a fan!

reviews.title: Great app!!!
reviews.text: It really helped me with my chronic ADHD. I would even say it cured it. Thank you mind flow!!!!!!

reviews.title: A Lifesaver for ADHD!
reviews.text:
Mindflow AI is exactly what I needed - a calming, intelligent voice companion that helps me manage the chaos of ADHD. It feels like having a supportive friend who’s always there to guide me through distractions, being overwhelmed, and emotional ups and downs.
The app adapts to how I’m feeling each day and offers personalized reminders, focus support, and even just someone to talk to and I need grounding. It’s not just another productivity app, it gets how ADHD actually works.
Highly recommend if you want real dash time support, structure, without pressure, and a judgment free tool to help you stay on track. Total game changer!

reviews.title: Super Helpful!
reviews.text: I rarely leave reviews, but I felt compelled to share my experience with Mindflow. It’s been a surprisingly powerful tool, especially for someone managing ADHD. I wish more therapists and coaches recommended it as a helpful companion between sessions. Within days, I started noticing patterns in my behavior that I’d never been able to pinpoint. The customized insights helped me look at long-standing habits in a new light. I’ve already told a few friends about it—definitely worth checking out.

reviews.title: Number One
reviews.text: The app’s insightful tips and gentle reminders help to stay positive. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for practical tools to boost productivity and well-being. It’s like having a personal coach right on your phone.

reviews.title: 👍🏻
reviews.text: I truly love this app. It helps you to be able to calm your mind down and focus better. I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This app has been such an amazing support tool for me. It’s incredibly accessible, which makes a huge difference especially during moments when I’m feeling extra anxious or overwhelmed. Just knowing I can open the app and get helpful guidance or calming tools right away brings me a real sense of relief. Highly recommend to anyone looking for mental wellness support that’s right there when you need it

reviews.title: worth the $$
reviews.text: i was hesitant to pay but the improvements this app has made to my life are so worth it. i felt like a burden talking to my friends about my struggles with productivity and the resulting depression, having this app takes that shame away.

reviews.title: Super helpful
reviews.text: I downloaded this app to use with my older son and have found it to be super helpful both in terms of the information provided as well as how to improve his behavior.

reviews.title: great app
reviews.text: Great onboarding experience with insightful questions. Recommendations and workflow are great. Big fan.

reviews.title: First app that worked
reviews.text: My ADHD has always been something I felt holding me back. I’ve started using Mindflow and it’s been a great way to be more mindful and make the right choices for me. Recommend to anyone

reviews.title: 10/10 helps with organizing my life
reviews.text: I'm not diagnosed with ADHD but but I often get overwhelmed with tons of tasks on my TODO list. Mindflow has completely changed how I handle my day. It’s a great way to structure tasks and mentally organize what's ahead, significantly reducing my mental overhead and anxiety around doing this alone. Sometimes I miss a day here or there but always come back and love how Mindflow remembers everything so we can pick back up immediately. Also love chat mode for when I’m in public places vs live mode for when I want to work through things realtime.

reviews.title: Love this app!
reviews.text: I was diagnosed with ADHD at 24, and Mindflow has helped me understand my brain in ways I never could on my own. Everything is genuinely relatable and feels custom-made for my daily challenges. The app delivers insightful content in a much easier-to-digest format compared to diving into books or lengthy articles about ADHD.

reviews.title: So good
reviews.text: I almost never write app reviews, but Mindflow truly deserves it. Honestly, I don't understand why this isn't recommended more by ADHD coaches or therapists as supplementary guidance between sessions. Instantly, I gained real insights about habits I've struggled with forever. After just a few days of usage, the personalized feedback had me genuinely rethinking some behaviors. Now I started sharing this app with friends. definitely worth giving this a shot.

reviews.title: 4 days in...
reviews.text: I've been using Mindflow for 4 days now. So far, the interactive assessments are fantastic, especially those helping me pinpoint specific triggers behind my ADHD symptoms and better understand how my mind works. Also, the AI voice companion is seriously impressive and provided immediate, helpful answers to all my questions. Out of every app I've tried with an AI component, this is hands-down one of the best.

reviews.title: I love MindFlow!
reviews.text: Mindflow has made a massive difference in my daily life. I've tried tons of ADHD-focused apps, but this is the first one that truly clicked for me. The voice assistant keeps dme in check because it feels like a literal person keeping me accountable. Thanks, genuinely making a difference!
